offensive.name: Answering Blow
offensive.description: A shield that only ever holds is half a shield.

tiers.text: The damage becomes force and gains +2 dice, plus additional damage equal to your Verum Modifier for each ally who has taken damage since your last turn (maximum 3).
tiers.card: +2 dice force · +{VM} more per ally hurt since your last turn (max 3)

tiers.text: +4 dice. The target has disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: +4 dice · disadvantage on its attacks against anyone but you

penalty.disadvantage: attack rolls against anyone but you until the end

tiers.text: +6 dice. If the target has damaged an ally this round, this effect ignores its resistances and immunities.
tiers.card: +6 dice · ignores resistance and immunity if it hurt an ally this round

tiers.text: +8 dice. For 1 minute, whenever an ally within 30 feet is hit by an attack, you may use your reaction to deal this effect's damage to the attacker at half value.
tiers.card: +8 dice · 1 min: react when an ally within 30 ft is hit to deal this damage at half to the attacker

supportive.name: Guardian's Shell
supportive.description: Create an arcane barrier to absorb damage — granting scaling temporary HP, damage resistance, and eventually reflecting resisted damage back at attackers as force.

tiers.text: You or one ally within 30 feet gains temporary hit points equal to 10 × the spell slot level used.
tiers.card: You or an ally within 30 ft: temp HP = 10 × slot level

tiers.text: The target instead gains temp HP equal to 20 × the spell slot level, and resistance to one damage type of your choice for 1 round.
tiers.card: Temp HP = 20 × slot · plus resistance to one damage type, 1 round

tiers.text: Resistance extends to two damage types, and the temp HP increases to 30 × the spell slot level.
tiers.card: Temp HP = 30 × slot · resistance to two types

tiers.text: The shell reflects incoming damage of the resisted type back at the attacker — the attacker takes 1d6 force damage per spell slot level used (Constitution save halves).
tiers.card: The shell reflects — attacker takes 1d6 force per slot level (Con half)

supportive.name: Impenetrable Will
supportive.description: Your protection weaves into the mind and soul — granting condition advantage, then immunity, and eventually a once-per-rest Legendary Resistance for one chosen ally.

tiers.text: Choose one condition (Frightened, Charmed, or Stunned) — the target gains advantage on saving throws against it for 1 minute.
tiers.card: Advantage against Frightened, Charmed or Stunned — pick one — for 1 min

buff.advantage: saving throws against it for 1 minute

tiers.text: The target is immune to the chosen condition for 1 minute.
tiers.card: Immune to that condition for 1 min instead

tiers.text: You may target two conditions — immunity applies to both for 1 minute.
tiers.card: Two conditions, immune to both, 1 min

tiers.text: Once per long rest, you may grant one affected ally Legendary Resistance — they may choose to automatically succeed on one saving throw before the effect ends.
tiers.card: 1/long rest: grant an ally one Legendary Resistance before it ends

supportive.name: Ward of the Guardian
supportive.description: Mark an ally for divine protection — imposing disadvantage on attackers, halving damage on hits, and eventually granting critical hit immunity and automatic save successes each round.

tiers.text: Designate one ally within 30 feet — attack rolls against them are made at disadvantage until the start of your next turn.
tiers.card: An ally within 30 ft is attacked at disadvantage until your next turn

tiers.text: If an attacker hits despite the ward, the target takes half damage and cannot suffer Wounds from that hit.
tiers.card: A hit that lands anyway deals half damage and causes no Wounds

tiers.text: You may mark two allies simultaneously, and each gains +2 AC for the duration.
tiers.card: Two allies warded · each gains +2 AC

tiers.text: Allies under your ward are immune to critical hits and may automatically succeed on one saving throw per round — you choose which save when it occurs.
tiers.card: Warded allies are immune to crits and auto-succeed one save per round, your call

control.name: Protective Pulse
control.description: Repel harm from all nearby — boosting AC, granting half cover, pushing enemies prone, and eventually dispelling magical effects targeting your allies within the radius.

tiers.text: When cast, allies within 10 feet gain +1 AC and cannot suffer Wounds until the start of your next turn.
tiers.card: Allies within 10 ft: +1 AC and no Wounds until your next turn

tiers.text: Radius increases to 20 feet, the AC bonus increases to +2, and allies gain half cover against ranged attacks.
tiers.card: 20 ft · +2 AC · half cover against ranged

tiers.text: Enemies in the area must succeed on a Strength save or be pushed 15 feet and knocked prone.
tiers.card: Enemies in the area: Str save or pushed 15 ft and prone

tiers.text: The pulse additionally dispels magical effects of 5th level or lower targeting your allies within the radius.
tiers.card: Also dispels effects of 5th or lower on your allies in the radius

creation.name: Bulwark of Faith
creation.description: To make a shield is to promise it will hold.

tiers.text: Allies behind a Structure gain +1 AC beyond its cover. A Construct may use its reaction to grant half cover to an ally within 5 feet. Objects made as shields or armor grant +1 AC.
tiers.card: Allies behind a Structure +1 AC past cover · Construct can react to give half cover · shield/armour Objects +1 AC

tiers.text: Your Structures are immune to nonmagical damage. A Construct adjacent to an ally may take a hit meant for them.
tiers.card: Structures immune to nonmagical damage · a Construct beside an ally can take a hit for them

tiers.text: Once per seal, you may raise the Structure as a reaction when an ally within range is targeted. Constructs have resistance to all damage while protecting someone.
tiers.card: 1/seal raise the Structure as a reaction when an ally is targeted · Constructs resist all damage while protecting

tiers.text: Sanctum: allies within 5 feet of a Structure are immune to forced movement and death effects, and a Structure that would be destroyed instead stands at 1 hit point until the start of your next turn.
tiers.card: Sanctum — allies within 5 ft immune to forced movement and death effects · a destroyed Structure holds at 1 HP

utility.name: Warding Rite
utility.description: A door does not need a guard if the guard is the door.

tiers.text: Ward a door, chest, or 10-foot area: it locks (opened with a check against your Verum DC) and alerts you when crossed.
tiers.card: Ward a door, chest or 10-ft area — locked ({DC} to open) and it alerts you when crossed

tiers.text: Ward a room for 8 hours against scrying and against teleportation into it.
tiers.card: Ward a room 8 hrs against scrying and teleport-in

tiers.text: Ward a place against a named creature type; they cannot willingly enter without succeeding on a Charisma save against your Verum DC.
tiers.card: Ward against a named creature type — they can't willingly enter without a Cha save {DC}

tiers.text: Sanctify a region up to 100 feet across: no hostile Arcanum Veritas of a lower slot than yours can be drawn inside it.
tiers.card: Sanctify 100 ft — no hostile seal of a lower slot than yours can be drawn inside

complementEffects.name: Retribution Ward
complementEffects.description: Strike the protected and the protection strikes back — a ward discharging force damage at every attacker who dares hit the warded creature.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, place a Retribution Ward on one creature within 30 feet for 1 minute. The next time that creature is hit by a melee or ranged attack, the attacker takes force damage equal to your spellcasting modifier + your proficiency bonus as the ward discharges.
effect.card: Ward a creature within 30 ft 1 min — first attacker to hit it takes {VM}+{PB} force

upgrades.text: The ward discharges on the first two attacks that hit rather than just the first, and the force damage increases to twice your spellcasting modifier + your proficiency bonus.
upgrades.card: Discharges on the first two hits · damage doubles

upgrades.text: The ward discharges on every attack that hits for 1 minute, dealing force damage equal to your spellcasting modifier + your proficiency bonus each time — protection becoming a persistent deterrent against striking the warded creature.
upgrades.card: Discharges on every hit for 1 min

complementEffects.name: Fortify
complementEffects.description: A moment of protection hardens those nearby — granting temporary HP, Constitution save advantage, and eventually immunity to the Frightened condition.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, one ally of your choice within 30 feet gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting modifier + your proficiency bonus and advantage on their next Constitution saving throw before the start of your next turn.
effect.card: An ally within 30 ft: {VM}+{PB} temp HP and advantage on their next Con save

buff.advantage: their next Constitution saving throw before the st

upgrades.text: The temporary HP increases to twice your spellcasting modifier + your proficiency bonus, and the advantage extends to all Constitution saving throws until the start of your next turn.
upgrades.card: Temp HP doubles · advantage on all Con saves until your next turn

upgrades.text: You may choose two allies to receive this benefit, and each is also immune to the Frightened condition until the start of your next turn — protection fortifying not just the body but the nerve.
upgrades.card: Two allies · each also immune to Frightened

complementEffects.name: Repel
complementEffects.description: Protection does not just hold — it pushes back, forcing the nearest enemy away from the protected target and eventually making approach feel actively impossible.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, the nearest enemy within 30 feet of the primary target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Verum DC or be pushed 15 feet directly away from the target.
effect.card: Nearest enemy within 30 ft of the target: Str save {DC} or pushed 15 ft away

upgrades.text: On a failed save, the enemy is also knocked prone after being pushed — the force of repulsion taking their footing with it.

You may choose up to two enemies within 30 feet to be affected, and creatures that fail are also unable to move toward the protected target until the end of their next turn — the ward making approach feel actively painful.
upgrades.card: Up to two enemies · those who fail can't move toward the protected target
